metric_config.scope: Fresh matched native N versus unchanged I75 tangent-heading overlay T across straight, arc and figure-eight paths and all three starting phases; no selected-route promotion, no tuning or automatic adoption.

heading_benefit.definition: Every T route/phase must have raw heading RMS<=max(.8N,5deg) and exact Euler-heading-rate error RMS<=max(.8N,.03rad/s). Label achieved20percent relative reductions separately from absolute-floor passes; zero-baseline cases never imply a relative improvement.
heading_benefit.actual_rate_definition: Let h=R(q)[:,0] and hdot=omega_world cross h. Exact Eulerheadingrate=(hx*hdot_y-hy*hdot_x)/(hx^2+hy^2); horizontal forwardprojection denominator must exceed1e-8. Physical world-z angularvelocity is a distinct diagnostic, not the primary rate.
heading_benefit.raw_target_policy: Frozen geometric tangent including holds; no measured-drift target. Figure-eight crossing has a nonzero geometric tangent and no cusp.
heading_benefit.command_target_policy: Rawanalytic C2target equals command target if frozen rate/accel guards pass. Any reference shaping/lag must be explicit, and raw objectives remain primary.

helper_activity.definition: Count actual held intervals with norm of recorded native heading_command[:3] at least threshold. Record original helper eligibility and lever/load masks separately.
helper_activity.limitation: This is helper activity before fade/clipping, not a full applied-command counterfactual. Actual clipping and fade are reported separately.

settling.scope: Original4conditions and original4 plus raw final geometric heading error<=10degrees. Explicit conditional4condition nonregression; no allphase convergence or settling-only adoption claim.
settling.nonregression: If N passes all original four conditions throughout the final2s, T must also pass those four. All four/five-condition results remain explicit; broad overlay screen success is not a claim of absolute convergence in every run.

hard_contracts: All eighteen episodes complete their registered45/45/133s, finite physicalstate/held commands, no declaredphysicalfailure, applied=clip(requested), caps and actualpriorhistory valid.

Sameroute/phase N/T initial q/v/previousactualinput byteexact; commonrequested yaw=that route geometric initial tangent and actualinitial rawheadingerror<=1degree. Do not assume Eulerheading equalsyawargument byteexactly.
RawXY/V/A clocks and rawtangent heading/rate/acceleration are common and match independent frozen routegeometry/progress at actualtimestamps. Fullpath and finalgoal stayfixed afterearlystop.

Only declared tangent-heading reference/helper adapter affectsT; native LQR,gaincache,observercount,normal/load/support/reference/preparation algorithms remain. Currentvalues can differ after trajectories diverge.
Raw and shaped telemetry distinguish both objectives. Shaped rate/accel bounds and command/helper identities verified; N heading helper remains zero.
No historical numerical replay gate; all eighteen episodes are fresh paired runs with route-specific aligned initial yaws.
All eighteen outputs must be sealed before scoring. Every one of nine route/phase pairs must pass; no postresult route, phase, threshold or candidate selection.
diagnostic_only: Physical world-z angularvelocity and itsintegrals/peaks reported separately from exact Eulerheadingrate; neither substituted for primary Euler-rateerror.
Absolute physicalrotation/travel and angularspeed are descriptive, since followingthe tangent requires intentional turning.
Raw versus shaped heading/rate lag, desired yawacceleration, helpereligibility/lever/load/torque and activity beforefade/clipping.

Detailed four/five-condition goalhold outcomes remain explicit. Four-condition preservation and geometric cross-track have declared nonregression gates; five-condition settling is descriptive. Final unheld commands are excluded from command statistics.
Actual jointspeed peaks and huge rolling-reference demands remain observable in rawlogs; no new assumed jointspeed bound is introduced.
status_precedence: FAIL_TANGENT_SCREEN ifany N/Tphysicalcondition, perroute/phase flooredrawheading/rate gate or nonregressionguard fails.
PASS_TANGENT_SCREEN onlyifallnine route/phase pairs pass allconditions; no automaticdefaultadoption.

reference_guards.raw_command_identity: Bothpolicies log commonplanned raw/command streams; no postresult targetfiltering or shaping. Rawanalyticrate/accel must satisfyguard before physics.

straight.moving_interval: Half-open [3,35); all physical-state windows otherwise include actual terminal state.
straight.command_interval: Exclude final emitted but unheld command; include actual prior input for command-step metrics.

arc.moving_interval: Half-open [3,35); all physical-state windows otherwise include actual terminal state.
arc.command_interval: Exclude final emitted but unheld command; include actual prior input for command-step metrics.

eight.moving_interval: Half-open [3,123); all physical-state windows otherwise include actual terminal state.
eight.command_interval: Exclude final emitted but unheld command; include actual prior input for command-step metrics.

routes.origin_policy: Actual origin=anchor+R113@route local offset. Eight translated prephysics after original corridor failed map relief/slope setup guards; shape/timing/headings and numeric control gates unchanged.

geometric_cross_track.parameter_sampling: Uniform geometric u in [0,1], including both endpoints; full intended path retained even after early failure.
geometric_cross_track.distance: Exact Euclidean point-to-segment minimum over the fixed dense polyline, computed in chunks. This is discretized geometric cross-track distance, not exact analytic curve distance.
geometric_cross_track.figure_eight_limitation: Nearest-path distance at the crossing can hide wrong progress; independent timed XY tracking stays a separate requirement.

metric_config.suite_decision: All9 matched route/phase pairs required. Report route-specific and pooled descriptive summaries, but do not select a winning route or drop a failed pair. Native LQR angular-reference policy and helper gains unchanged from I75 minimal overlay. Route origins and initial terrain differ. Compare N/T within each matched route/phase; cross-route differences do not isolate path shape or establish equal difficulty.

fixture_domain_revision.interpretation: Straight and arc are moderate fixtures. Eight is an explicit rough-stress case outside the unchanged moderate screen, not a passed moderate case. Within-route paired N/T comparisons only; different initial terrain and route difficulty prevent isolated-shape claims.
fixture_domain_revision.performance_decision: All nine route/phase performance pairs and every numeric control criterion remain required; rough-stress classification does not waive performance failures.

controller_scope: Minimal tangent-heading overlay. Native LQR angular-velocity reference remains zero; its rate feedback can compete with commanded turns. Results do not establish impossibility of fully reference-consistent tangent tracking.
lqr_rate_reference_policy: Original LQR angular-velocity reference remains zero; original rolling allocation handles translation only. This is a heading-helper overlay, not a coordinated planar-pose reference/allocator. Existing rate feedback may oppose intended turns and its contribution is logged via K/error.

cross_route_scope: Eight origin translated before physics after the original corridor failed map setup guards. Initial terrain differs by route; compare N/T within each route/phase, without equal-difficulty or isolated-shape claims.
interpretation: Trajectory-tangent heading with exact Euler-rate feedback versus native observer baseline. Raw geometric objectives are primary; command-target lag separately reported. Physical world-z angular velocity is diagnostic, not Euler heading rate. No historical numerical replay gate; route-specific initial yaws match each raw tangent. No automatic adoption; four-condition settling preserved if baseline passes; all five-condition outcomes explicit.
